requirements.english: TOEFL iBT 80 — or 4.5 for tests from 21 Jan 2026 — or pBT 550 · IELTS 6.5 with every sub-score 5.5; waived for an English-medium degree
requirements.admission_model: Department admission with a named supervisor; rolling review
requirements.admission_model_note: Applications open 1 Sep 2026 for Fall 2027/28 and departments review on a rolling basis, so the posted deadline is a backstop rather than the real one. HKPFS runs on a separate track: an initial application to the RGC and a full application to HKUST, both due 1 Dec 2026.

funding.note: Postgraduate Studentship HK$229,620/yr, awarded with the offer and needing no separate application. HKPFS pays HK$344,400/yr for 4 years plus HK$14,400 travel. RedBird adds HK$40,000 in year one for international PhDs. Tuition HK$49,500/yr for 2027/28.
